propositions: Provider-qualified model references (e.g., 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError because genai-prices expects bare model ids, causing rows to silently drop to 'unpriced' with no warning.

The asymmetric failure affects Anthropic and OpenAI providers but not Bedrock, causing provider cost comparisons to show figures only for Bedrock while other providers appear blank, creating a false bias about relative costs.

The LookupError exception is caught and swallowed at usage_log.py:429 before reaching the WARNING branch, making failures invisible to users who see only 'est. cost excludes N unpriced calls' without understanding why.

Model id translation from provider-qualified form to bare form must use registry membership (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than string splitting, because naïve prefix stripping breaks versioned Bedrock ids like 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'.

Genuinely unknown models must remain tolerated as unpriced (pricing is best-effort) but should be distinguishable in output from mis-formatted ids, allowing users to separate unknown models from resolution failures.
